promotions.behavior: Reforged organization lifecycle and rank permission enforcement
assumptions: This is compatibility infrastructure, not a claim that player-created Classic guilds existed.
tests: --smoke-organizations: creation, ranks, invitations, promotion, chat routing, transfer, leave, disband, fail-closed player creation
promotions.safeFallback: Reject unknown organizations, ranks, permissions, and player creation.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Provides deterministic organization coordination and authorization.
promotions.worldStateImpact: In-memory organization state only; restart persistence disabled.

promotions.behavior: Guild chat routing derives recipients from authoritative organization membership
assumptions: Guild-like membership is exclusive for chat routing.
Exact Classic guild channel availability remains unresolved.
promotions.safeFallback: Fail guild routing when membership or speak permission is absent.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Reads organization membership without mutating it.
